title: Design Blueprint
description: Phase 4 artifact produced by Creative Director. Records design decisions, incorporates Composition Plan as embedded component, and references Design Intent Statement from Creative Direction artifact. Per artifact-contracts.md section 5.5.
$comment: COMPOSITION PLAN IS EMBEDDED: Per artifact-contracts.md section 5.11, the Composition Plan is a component of this blueprint record, not a peer artifact. DESIGN INTENT BY REFERENCE: Per section 5.10 and section 6 invariant 7, the Design Intent Statement is authored in Creative Direction and consumed here by reference only. UNRESOLVED GAPS: Several contract-required concepts lack defined shapes in Phase 4 canonical source.

allOf.$comment: REQUIRED FOR DESIGN BLUEPRINT: artifact-contracts.md section 7 'Applies to' table explicitly lists Design Blueprint as requiring all four registry versions: parameter, design language, phase ownership, critic metrics.

designIntentReference.description: Reference to Design Intent Statement in Creative Direction artifact. Per artifact-contracts.md section 5.10 and section 6 invariant 7, the Design Intent Statement is authored in Creative Direction and consumed here by reference only. The Blueprint does not re-author it.
designIntentReference.$comment: REFERENCE SHAPE UNRESOLVED: schema-architecture.md section 4.3 concern J states what by reference means as a shape is not stated anywhere. This minimal reference structure identifies the authoritative Creative Direction artifact and version consumed.

creativeDirectionArtifactId.description: Artifact ID of the Creative Direction artifact containing the authoritative Design Intent Statement.

creativeDirectionVersion.description: Exact version of the Creative Direction artifact consumed, per artifact-contracts.md section 7 rule on exact consumed versions.

strategy.description: Design strategy parameters and selections. Phase 4 section 36.2.

primaryLanguage.description: Selected primary visual grammar. Canonical set from design-language-registry.md section 1: DL-01 Editorial Luxury, DL-02 Swiss/Structured, DL-03 Bold Energetic, DL-04 Soft Premium/Wellness, DL-05 Architectural/Sophisticated. V1 locked set.

secondaryInfluence.description: Secondary design language influence. Phase 4 section 17. May be same as primaryLanguage per section 17.

creativeIntensity.description: Creative intensity 1-10. Phase 4 section 18, parameter-registry.md. NOT bounded by creativeBudget per parameter-registry.md section 2.3.

contentDensity.description: Content density classification. Phase 4 section 21, parameter-registry.md.

creativeRisk.description: Creative risk assessment. Phase 4 section 19.1 and section 36.2. REGISTRY-ABSENT: No parameter-registry.md entry, no declared scale.
creativeRisk.$comment: UNCONSTRAINED: Phase 4 section 19.1 states no scale declared, no canonical machine type. Section 36.2 flags as registry-absent. Illustrative value 3 does not establish its type. No schema restriction is therefore imposed.

competitorSameness.description: Competitive landscape sameness. Phase 4 section 15.2 and section 36.2. REGISTRY-ABSENT: No parameter-registry.md entry, no declared scale.
competitorSameness.$comment: UNCONSTRAINED: Section 36.2 flags as registry-absent. Canonical machine type unresolved. Phase 4 uses Low/Medium/High terminology and illustrative value 'high'. No machine type is therefore imposed.

brandMaturity.description: Brand maturity assessment. Phase 4 section 12.1 and section 36.2. CONFLICTING SCALES: Phase 2 section 13 uses categorical (Mature/Developing/Weak), Phase 4 section 4.10 uses 1-10 numeric.
brandMaturity.$comment: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: Two incompatible scales per Phase 4 section 12.1. Section 36.2 marks as contested. Preserved as minimally permissive oneOf without choosing or inventing mapping.

sections.description: COMPOSITION PLAN COMPONENT (embedded). Ordered list of section identifiers. Order is the section 26 sequencing decision. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.11: concrete section sequence. Phase 4 section 36.2.

composition.description: COMPOSITION PLAN COMPONENT (embedded). Per-section arrangement and pattern selections. Phase 4 section 36.2. Keys are section identifiers from sections array. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.11: per-section arrangement, pattern selections.

mode.description: Composition mode. Phase 3 section 9: C01 Typographic Dominant, C02 Image Dominant, C03 Information Efficient, C04 Product/Service Grid, C05 Media-First/Immersive, C06 Narrative/Story, C07 Human/Social Proof, C08 Location/Spatial, C09 Hybrid/Layered, C10 Atmospheric/Cinematic.

pattern.description: Pattern ID. Phase 3 section 11 family-prefixed format. LIBRARY EMPTY: 0 of approximately 87 patterns specified per artifact-contracts.md section 8 item 5 and Phase 4 section 29.2. Cannot enumerate valid IDs.
pattern.$comment: Pattern Library is provisional/incomplete per schema-architecture.md section 4.6. Canonical identifier grammar is not yet defined. Schema intentionally does not impose regex constraint.

rhythm.description: COMPOSITION PLAN COMPONENT (embedded). Visual rhythm sequence. Phase 4 section 32.3, Phase 3 section 17. Phase 4 section 36.2 pacing field.

anchors.description: COMPOSITION PLAN COMPONENT (embedded). Visual anchor identifiers. Phase 4 section 32.1. Phase 4 section 36.2 pacing field.

sectionRelationships.description: COMPOSITION PLAN COMPONENT (embedded). Narrative transitions between sections. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.11: narrative transitions between sections. Phase 4 section 36.2 records no field exists for section relationships despite section 31 defining them.
sectionRelationships.$comment: CONTRACT-REQUIRED OPEN STRUCTURE: Contract section 5.11 requires this concept but Phase 4 section 36.2 states no field exists. Internal serialization shape unresolved. Open structure provided per human decision Q2.

imagery.description: Imagery strategy tied to approved assets. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.5: imagery strategy tied to approved assets.
imagery.$comment: CONTRACT-REQUIRED OPEN STRUCTURE: Contract requires this concept but Phase 4 section 36.2 has no corresponding field structure. Internal serialization shape unresolved per human decision Q2. No asset ID formats invented.

constraints.description: Explicitly stated constraints. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.5: explicitly stated constraints.
constraints.$comment: CONTRACT-REQUIRED OPEN STRUCTURE: Contract requires this concept but Phase 4 section 36.2 has no corresponding field structure. Internal serialization shape unresolved per human decision Q2.

accessibility.description: Accessibility expectations. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.5: accessibility and SEO expectations. Foundation-owned absolute property per schema-architecture.md section 3.8: absolute, non-tradeable, non-overridable, not weighted, outside creative exception mechanism.
accessibility.$comment: Requirements capture only. No WCAG levels, contrast ratios, touch targets, scores, or thresholds invented per human decision accessibility rules. Enforcement in quality gates.

seo.description: SEO expectations. Required per artifact-contracts.md section 5.5: accessibility and SEO expectations.
seo.$comment: Requirements capture only. No keyword strategy, rankings, search volume, keyword counts, or SEO scores invented per human decision SEO rules.

name.description: Business name. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

industry.description: Industry classification. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

location.description: Business location. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

truth.description: Truth classification per artifact-contracts.md section 2. Phase 4 section 36.2. Three keys correspond exactly to section 5 VERIFIED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN classes.

verifiedClaims.description: VERIFIED truth class. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field. Collection without stated element shape.

inferredTraits.description: INFERRED truth class. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field. Collection without stated element shape.

unknowns.description: UNKNOWN truth class. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field. Collection without stated element shape.

strategy.description: Narrative strategy identifier. Phase 4 section 23 and section 36.2. Emitted as slug, not N01-N08 ID.

chapters.description: Narrative chapter sequence. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

checks.description: Pre-gate self-checks. Phase 4 section 36.2. Four checks only; Creative Quality Gate section 37 asks nine questions with no one-to-one correspondence per section 40.

truth.description: Truth check. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

conversion.description: Conversion check. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

usability.description: Usability check. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field. No corresponding gate question per section 40.

accessibility.description: Accessibility check. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field.

score.description: Novelty score. Phase 4 section 36.2 source field. No scale declared.
